diff --git a/lsize.py b/lsize.py
index 4cf9025..0d6c671 100644
--- a/lsize.py
+++ b/lsize.py
@@ -4,7 +4,16 @@ import sys
 
 
 def format_size(n):
-    return f"{n} B"
+    """Human-readable size using powers of 1000 (matches Finder)."""
+    if n < 1000:
+        return f"{n} B"
+    value = float(n)
+    for unit in ("KB", "MB", "GB"):
+        value /= 1000
+        text = f"{value:.1f}"
+        # If rounding would show 1000.0, move up to the next unit.
+        if float(text) < 1000 or unit == "GB":
+            return f"{text} {unit}"
 
 
 def list_sizes(folder):

index 02077d7..63cd1a9 100644
--- a/tests/test_lsize.py
+++ b/tests/test_lsize.py
@@ -4,6 +4,23 @@ from lsize import format_size, list_sizes, main
 def test_small_sizes_in_bytes():
     assert format_size(0) == "0 B"
     assert format_size(512) == "512 B"
+    assert format_size(999) == "999 B"
+
+
+def test_kb_mb_gb_use_base_1000():
+    assert format_size(1000) == "1.0 KB"
+    assert format_size(1500) == "1.5 KB"
+    assert format_size(20_300_000) == "20.3 MB"
+    assert format_size(2_000_000_000) == "2.0 GB"
+
+
+def test_rounding_rolls_over_to_next_unit():
+    assert format_size(999_949) == "999.9 KB"
+    assert format_size(999_950) == "1.0 MB"
+
+
+def test_huge_sizes_stay_in_gb():
+    assert format_size(1_500_000_000_000) == "1500.0 GB"
 
 
 def test_list_sizes_biggest_first(tmp_path):
@@ -17,3 +34,9 @@ def test_main_prints_names(tmp_path, capsys):
     (tmp_path / "notes.txt").write_bytes(b"hello")
     assert main([str(tmp_path)]) == 0
     assert "notes.txt" in capsys.readouterr().out
+
+
+def test_main_prints_readable_size(tmp_path, capsys):
+    (tmp_path / "big.bin").write_bytes(b"x" * 1500)

+    assert "1.5 KB" in capsys.readouterr().out
